summary: Occurrence (GBIF), climate grids (WorldClim 2.1) and thermal tolerance limits (GlobTherm) are open, and a CC0 compilation of beyond-range transplant experiments exists (Hargreaves 2013, Dryad c3287); no dataset found classifies a large set of range edges as biotic or climatic, so the central comparison needs compiling.
